title: Peptide reconstitution calculator
formula: concentration (mcg/mL) = mass in vial (mg) x 1000 / diluent volume (mL). volume to draw (mL) = mass wanted (mcg) / concentration. syringe units = volume to draw (mL) x units per mL on the chosen scale (100, 50 or 40). whole draws per vial = floor(mass in vial (mcg) / mass per draw (mcg)). Worked example: 5 mg in 2 mL is 2500 mcg/mL; 250 mcg is 0.1 mL; on a U-100 syringe that is 10 units, on a U-40 it is 4.
summary: Converts vial mass, diluent volume and a chosen mass per draw into a concentration, a volume and that volume in syringe units on a U-100, U-50 or U-40 scale. It warns when a draw falls below the smallest graduation on the syringe or exceeds its capacity. It takes no body weight and no condition, and it never returns a dose.
open_questions: Whether to add a bacteriostatic-water volume preset for common vial sizes, which risks implying a recommended reconstitution rather than reporting arithmetic.

changelog.change: Record created so the tool can be indexed. The calculator itself was rebuilt the same day: the unit converter and vial planner had no calculator at all, only a description.
